text: I've been up with my grandson most of the night and I'm completely done in so forgive me if this doesn't make much sense. He's 2. He's had a fever since yesterday afternoon, last check it was 38.9. About an hour ago I was changing him and saw some small dark red spots on his legs and a couple on his belly, little ones like someone's dotted him with a pen. I pressed the side of a drinking glass on them because I remembered that from somewhere and they didn't go away, I could still see them clear as anything through the glass. The other thing that's bothering me is he's just not himself. Normally even poorly he'd be grizzling and wanting his cup and fighting me over the nappy, but tonight he just lay there and let me do it, all limp like a rag doll. I've had to really jiggle him and say his name a few times to get him to open his eyes and even then he doesn't really look at me properly before he drifts off again. His breathing seems normal enough, I've been watching his chest and it's going up and down steady, no noise or anything. His parents are on their way back but they're a couple of hours off. I don't know whether to wait for them or what.
